text: flavor.ts does not follow the service conventions the spec requires of logic files: it exports two functions (todaysFlavor, announceFlavor) rather than a single `run`, returns plain strings instead of `Result<T>`, and provides no consumer-grade error message — `todaysFlavor` divides by `parlors.length` with no guard for an empty store, so it would crash or produce garbage instead of returning an actionable error.

old-rotation.ts is an orphaned file: its own comment says it is 'Kept around in case we go back to the old rotation,' so it is dead code not reachable from the feature's entry point and not part of the feature's public API. The cohesion rule requires every file in the directory to be reachable from `index.ts` through its import graph; this file must be removed or actually wired into the feature.

The error message for an invalid minReviews is exactly "invalid input", which the specification explicitly names as unacceptable. The Behavior section requires error messages to name what was wrong and what would be accepted instead (e.g., "minReviews must be a whole number from 0 or greater"). The message must be rewritten to state the problem and the accepted alternative.
